authorization: User requested first-principles analysis and authorized further reliable Metis experiments on 2026-10-18.
excluded: D_TruePitch_Diagnostic receives unavailable current pitch under some conditions and is not deployable there. All seven other archived model families remain competitors, including score controls.

stages.maturity: Each preceding issue+horizon+release must be strictly earlier than the next stage start. Boundary issues excluded identically for every condition and candidate. Exact retained coordinates are archived.

offset_method: Global signed higher-quantile of s-max(raw,0) on offset_fit only. Action=max(max(raw,0)+offset,0). Higher offset levels are post-processing actions under an unchanged rho10 loss, not changed E04/E07 q* or risk caps.
historical_choice: For each condition and base variant choose one shared quantile level across five seeds. Among levels whose simultaneous selection-stage violation upper bound is <=0.10 for EVERY archived seed, minimize mean selection cost; tie by lower quantile. If none qualify, retain q=.99 as an explicitly unqualified diagnostic fallback. Evaluation outcomes never alter this choice.

complexity.scope: Incremental reserve-layer resource order conditional on the same common external forecast; its identical upstream cost is shared, not asserted free end-to-end.
complexity.ties: Report all equally simple eligible candidates; serialized bytes and elapsed prediction seconds also reported, not post-hoc reorder criteria.
complexity.notes: E still consumes consequence signals and a separate predictor. WindBins deliberately ignores available inputs and is a restricted-resource candidate, not an equal-input representation control. Historical pitch supervision remains permitted.

inference.unit: Shared contiguous index-day blocks; all seeds and conditions share temporal draws. No seed resampling; mean cost conditional on five frozen instances, risk checked for every instance.
inference.simultaneous_method: Symmetric bootstrap maximum standardized deviation envelope across all declared metric coordinates. Selection envelope includes all conditions/seeds/variants/offset risks. Evaluation envelope jointly includes all condition/seed candidate risks and all condition-wise candidate mean-cost ratios, covering the entire epsilon curve. Approximate dependent-data bounds, not distribution-free guarantees.
inference.risk_zero_variance_rule: Set bounds to [0,1] for empirically constant risk coordinates; do not interpret a degenerate bootstrap as zero uncertainty.
inference.epsilon_role: Descriptive sensitivity tolerances, not certified engineering requirements and not modifications to original zero tolerances.
inference.possible_feasible: A candidate is possible-feasible when max_seed lower(violation)<=0.10. This retains every truly feasible competitor on the joint coverage event.
inference.selection_rule: Candidate m must have passed historical choice, max_seed upper(V_m)<=0.10, and max over possible-feasible competitors k of upper(C_m/C_k-1)<=epsilon. Choose all eligible minimum-resource candidates. Allow no risk-qualified policy and uncertainty about near-optimality.
inference.universe: Seven policies produced by the frozen historical offset-choice procedure, not all possible actions, all models, or all offset-grid policies. The complete offset grid is separately retained for descriptive diagnostics.
inference.evaluation_role: Already inspected development window. Any evaluation-side identified set is retrospective identification, not an ex-ante deployable selection or independent confirmation.

immutability: Parent source, model, coordinate and raw-action manifests verified before reading. Calibration raw predictions saved in a new bundle; evaluation reuses exact parent raw actions. No retraining or rewriting parent arrays. No E04/E07 activation, threshold change or scientific claim upgrade.
success_outputs: historical offset choice with maturity coordinates
remaining_evidence: second estimator and sample-size learning curves
engineering choice of practical cost tolerance
stop_rules: Do not tune levels or caps after new outputs. If no policy qualifies, report no qualified policy. Do not add models to force a winner. Cost benefits at unequal risk are not certified risk dominance.
